_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-01. CardID = 17600 + idx; 368 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 68). The deck object of the save holds 31 cards: the 30 of the deck plus the character card, which is why the catalog says card_count 31.

Restriction band (RAPHAEL, CASEY or ANY) and copies (xN printed on each card) read from the images; value, boost and type match unmatched-memory for all 12 titles. Attack cards carry the burst icon, versatile ones the burst-and-shield icon, Heroes In A Half Shell the shield, the scheme the lightning bolt.

Discrepancies with unmatched-memory (the real card wins; entries with `text` overwrite the importer's text): Break Something says 'AFTER COMBAT' (unmatched-memory has the typo 'AFTER COMBAR'); the scheme's second paragraph is 'Draw 1 card.' with the full stop; Relentless says 'into your deck' (unmatched-memory: 'in your deck'). Sai has no text at all: it is a vanilla versatile card, not a missing effect. Heroes In A Half Shell is a vanilla defense.
Titles keep unmatched-memory's capitalisation ('Break something', 'Unbridled rage'): the CardID, not the title, identifies a card on the table.
Casey Jones: one sidekick, ranged, 8 life, move 2 (hero card image). The save bag holds a standee (Custom_Token) and a miniature for him and two miniatures for Raphael (see data/tts/raphael.json).
ANGER ISSUES is a trigger on the `combat_lost` event (docs/effects-dsl.md, section 'Raphael'); no counters, forms or passives.
